{{Sagittarius}}
Sagittarius 4 is the 4th day of the year in the [[Gaian calendar]]. It is the 4th day of Sagittarius, and it is a Thursday. It corresponds to ISO week 1, weekday 4.

Its informal Japanese name is 1宮4日.

On this day, [[Gaiad chapter 4|Chapter 4]] of the [[Gaiad]] is read.

To see structured data on this date see {{q|Q152024}}.
